description: Bill Owen is a reliable, common-sense leader committed to serving Iowa with honesty and integrity. He’s focused on protecting taxpayers, supporting hardworking families, strengthening rural communities, and ensuring our schools and local economies remain strong. Bill listens to the people he serves and brings practical solutions, steady leadership, and a genuine dedication to building a safer, more prosperous future for every Iowan.
